$btc
 
First things first: macro (monthly chart) plan updated

With a major move just performed by the market in a very short period of recent time, quite literally in one day, it has implications on the larger timeframe due to the sheer extent of the move, but also the volume and breach of the general rhythm of boredom we saw recently.

That's a good thing. The fact we paid a short loss for it is less favourable.

In terms of chart analysis, the impact should IMO not be ignored. That's exactly the reason to not jump in another high conviction trade straight away. Instead, do the opposite, close some high conviction trades, just like we with some long runners a few hours ago.

Because from this local coming consolidation, new runners can be built potentially with still a long road up to go.

So after a large move, indeed comes consolidation next, which is what we will see imo.

And inevitably, our "next trade" will have to stem from the next local consolidation/range we anticipate forming.

More on what's next locally. But in terms of the higher timeframes now, we remind ourselves to our estimate of 60k to be the bottom, and where that means that this type of large push we just saw Yesterday, is part of that bottom being confirmed, and therefore should not be ignored.

We had a lot of confirmation and confluence of our 60k bottom call. By that I mean "4+ years worth of confirmation", including the sentiment, how everyone called for a bottom in Q4, how my call received a lot of backlash "Astro we are at 58k, you are wrong", but that's in our favour. It means the sentiment backs up our claims in contrarian manner.

So in short, macro (monthly) is going absolutely to plan. It's a consolation prize to say the least.

And so the key message is that given our macro plan, this move we just had should not be faded just like that, let alone shorted against blindly with "new lows in Q4" in mind. As mentioned many times, Q4 lows believers may end up paying for it, and not in the sense of losing 1 short, but in the sense of missing a generational entry which can end up costing much much more.

That's the first baseline for when I start shifting down timeframes in the next posts.

So I will shift down slowly next. For now, I already reiterated the bottom idea, why isn't unlikely in Q4, but is already in. Will share more reiterations of local timeframes, the significance of the 7.12% bounce and the spot buy.

On the chart also the monthly range we talked about, how we swept the low and how it now reached that midpoint area. That's not "resistance" per se but confirmation of the range, before higher, and a notion to some consolidation locally next, but not a move back down on imo.
